subject: general
question: What was India’s rank among the most polluted countries in the World Air Quality Report 2024, released in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**5th**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **World Air Quality Report 2024**, which was released by the **Swiss organization IQAir** in **March 2025**, **India** was ranked as the **5th** most polluted country globally.
 
• The report evaluates air quality based on the concentration of **PM2.5** (particulate matter with a diameter of 2.5 micrometers or less), which is considered the most harmful pollutant to human health.
 
• **India's** average annual **PM2.5** concentration was found to be significantly higher than the **World Health Organization (WHO)** annual air quality guideline of **5 µg/m³**.
 
• The **2024** report highlighted that a vast majority of the world's most polluted cities are located in **India**, particularly within the **Indo-Gangetic Plain** region.
 
• While **India** showed slight improvements in certain urban pockets compared to previous years, it remains a "high-pollution" zone due to industrial, vehicular, and construction activities. ***Hence, the correct answer is 5th.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Understanding PM2.5:**
 
 
• **PM2.5** refers to fine particulate matter that can penetrate deep into the **lungs** and enter the **bloodstream**, leading to **respiratory** and **cardiovascular** diseases.
 
• The **WHO** updated its guidelines in **September 2021**, stating that annual average concentrations of **PM2.5** should not exceed **5 µg/m³**.
 
 
 
• **Most Polluted Global Rankings:**
 
 
• In recent reports, countries like **Bangladesh**, **Pakistan**, and **Tajikistan** have frequently occupied the top three spots alongside **India**.
 
• In the **2024** data, **Bangladesh** and **Pakistan** continued to report **PM2.5** levels more than **10 to 15 times** the **WHO** guideline.
 
 
 
• **Indian City Rankings:**
 
 
• Cities like **Begusarai**, **New Delhi**, and **Mullanpur** often feature in the list of the world's most polluted metropolitan areas.
 
• **New Delhi** has repeatedly been categorized as the most polluted **capital city** in the world in various editions of the **IQAir** report.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives in India:**
 
 
• The **National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)** was launched by the **Government of India** in **January 2019** to tackle air pollution in **131 cities**.
 
• The program aims for a **20% to 30%** reduction in **PM2.5** and **PM10** concentrations by **2024** (later revised to a **40%** reduction target by **2026**) compared to **2017** levels.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Primary Sources:** The main contributors to air pollution in **India** include **biomass burning**, **vehicle emissions**, **coal-fired power plants**, and **stubble burning** during the winter months in **Punjab** and **Haryana**.
 
• **Economic Impact:** According to various studies, air pollution costs **India** billions of dollars annually due to **healthcare expenses** and lost **labor productivity**.
 
• **Global Context:** The **World Air Quality Report** utilizes data from over **30,000** air quality monitoring stations across more than **7,000** locations in **130+ countries**.

67
